about: WP49: tab- and right-aligned layouts read as columns or tables. A (right-tab fields are not a column) and D (contents pages in levels, and leader lines keep their indent) ship ON; C2 (no picture paints text the page also writes) ships OFF behind its switch; C1 (multi-rectangle cell paths) dropped after the promised census; B (underlined section headings) cut to 0.3.0b2. Measured on the wp49 tree merged with integration 234a77f (90db76d) against 234a77f. Every rule is off under the gdocs profile (infer(tab_layouts=False)) and has its own switch in infer.WP49_RULES.
baseline: 234a77f (WP50's listed sweeps: corpus wp50-b1-prod / wp50-a1-raw, holdout-1 C:\lotmp\wp50x\hold\b1-*)

gate.tests: 1998 OK (2 skipped, 2 expected failures: the B and C1 fixtures, deferred)

moved: y28_doe_oig_word365 (D indent: two appendix contents entries at source x 90 were set at the margin)

text_drawn_twice.what: characters of written text whose source box centre lies inside a picture's clip on the same page, standard profile infer(), 132 documents
text_drawn_twice.shipping (C2 off): unchanged from base: no document rises
text_drawn_twice.why_C2_is_off: with C2 on, y06 (135->136 pages), y38 (47->48), y47 (65->67) and y59 (dy_p50 33.5->41.5) regress beyond gate.py tolerances against final-910e6aa: a tint's picture held text that the flow now sets longer. All four are unpromised; criterion 8 covers every document.

C1_promised_census: of the 8 holdout-1 documents that drew text twice, 2 are promised under amendment 6 (h08 LaTeX notes, h27 ECB Word bulletin; one page each); the multi-rectangle cell-path mechanism's main case is the Berkshire annual report (not promised). Dropped per the review's rule.
D_last_non_space_glyph: checked: on the CISA contents page the last non-space glyph of every level-1 number ends at 543.3 and every level-2 number at 539.5 (rawdict per-glyph boxes), so measuring at the last non-space glyph does not unify the levels; the levels reading is kept, with one stop at the outermost edge and an x15-style negative (unit and end-to-end).
criterion_2: not timed: deferred to the quiet serial timing in the release measurement (owner's request, 2026-10-11; the machine was busy). A runs only on pages the block-cluster two-column test already split; D only where the single-edge leader reading kept nothing; C2 is off.
fixtures: tests/wp49_fixtures.py (reportlab, generated at test time): right_tab_resume, two_column_prose, grid_aligned_columns, right_aligned_sidebar, two_level_contents, fixed_dot_contents, underlined_sections, booktabs_table, zebra_multirect_table, one_path_bar_chart, one_path_horizontal_bars; tests/test_wp49_tab_layouts.py
follow_ups: B (0.3.0b2): resume rows pass build_rules_table's 60% two-fragment test (multi >= 0.6 rows), so section underlines bound a rules table; a captioned booktabs table also has a lone line over its top rule, so the heading-underline rule needs another discriminator
C1: split a fill path of disjoint axis-aligned rectangles in an infer pre-pass (standard profile only), with the review's guards
C2: a tint's picture refused only where the covered text is another element's, or the tint drawn behind the text as a float, to avoid the four corpus regressions
A: a right field beside a left label narrower than _ROW_MIN_LEFT (e.g. 'Lakeside Academy') stays unpaired
